summary: Tested Bug fix #1 (Resource Dashboard 'My Weekly Timesheet' widget) and Bug fix #2 (inline edit of current-week Draft entries on /my-timesheets). Frontend UI works end-to-end: widget renders on dashboard, banner text updated, edit icon appears on Draft rows in current week, inline inputs (planned/actual/notes) show, Save/Cancel work and 'Entry updated' toast fires. Backend PUT /api/timesheets/{id} persists actual_hours and notes correctly. Discovered one backend bug: planned_hours edits are silently dropped because the TimesheetUpdate Pydantic schema is missing the planned_hours field.

critical.issue: planned_hours sent by frontend inline edit is silently dropped. TimesheetUpdate schema (/app/backend/models/schemas.py line 385-390) only declares actual_hours, notes, status, task_id, task_name. Pydantic drops the extra 'planned_hours' field so users can appear to change planned hours but the value never persists. Confirmed via pytest: sent planned=3.5, response still shows 5.0. Fix: add `planned_hours: Optional[float] = None` to TimesheetUpdate and recalc variance when planned_hours changes (variance_hours = actual - planned).

integration_issues.flow: Dashboard 'My Weekly Timesheet' widget row rendering
integration_issues.issue: For the test entry we created (Data Migration project, valid project_id + phase_id), the TimesheetWeeklyCheckin widget on the ResourceDashboard displays 'Unknown Project / Unknown Client' in the row even though /api/timesheets/history returns the correct project_name for the same entry. Likely the widget uses a different endpoint (e.g. /api/timesheets/my-week) that isn't enriching project_name for entries whose project the resource isn't allocated to. Not caused by the current fix — pre-existing behavior of TimesheetWeeklyCheckin — but user-visible on the new dashboard widget.

action_items: Add `planned_hours: Optional[float] = None` to TimesheetUpdate schema in /app/backend/models/schemas.py (line 385). Also update /app/backend/routes/timesheets.py update_timesheet handler so that when planned_hours changes, variance_hours/variance_percentage are recalculated using the new planned value.

(Optional / pre-existing) Investigate why the ResourceDashboard 'My Weekly Timesheet' widget shows 'Unknown Project' for a valid timesheet entry — likely enrichment gap in the endpoint feeding TimesheetWeeklyCheckin.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix #2 UI code correctly restricts edit icon to isCurrentWeek && status === 'Draft' — good.
MyTimesheets.js WeekBlock uses useEffect+useRef to auto-close edit mode once updatingId returns to null — clean pattern.

TimesheetUpdate schema (schemas.py:385) is missing planned_hours — root cause of the failing update. This is a mismatch between the new frontend contract (sends 3 fields) and the existing backend Pydantic model.

Backend update_timesheet only recalculates variance when actual_hours changes; even after adding planned_hours to the schema, the variance recalculation branch must be extended to trigger when planned_hours changes too (otherwise variance goes stale).

rca_of_the_issue: TimesheetUpdate Pydantic model in /app/backend/models/schemas.py:385-390 does not declare planned_hours. FastAPI/Pydantic default config drops unknown fields silently. When the new MyTimesheets inline-edit UI PUTs {planned_hours, actual_hours, notes}, only actual_hours and notes are extracted by `update.dict(exclude_unset=True)`. Backend then only updates those two fields in Mongo. UI shows 'Entry updated' toast (backend returned 200) so the user believes the change persisted; on refresh planned_hours reverts to old value. Reproduction: login as riley, /my-timesheets, edit a Draft entry, change planned_hours only, click Save — refresh page — planned_hours is unchanged. Mitigation: add `planned_hours: Optional[float] = None` to TimesheetUpdate and in update_timesheet route recalc variance whenever planned_hours OR actual_hours is in update_data.
